# ThrottleAwareStrategy

- Namespace/type: `PPDS.Dataverse.Pooling.Strategies.ThrottleAwareStrategy`
- Assembly: `PPDS.Dataverse`

## Summary

Avoids throttled connections and falls back to round-robin among available connections. If all connections are throttled, returns the connection with shortest remaining throttle time.
